Definition: from G1503; a likeness, i.e. (literally) statue, profile, or (figuratively) representation, resemblance:--image.
BiblicalUsage: An image is a likeness, a representation that shows what the original is like, and the New Testament uses it for Christ and for us. Christ is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature, and believers are being renewed in knowledge after the image of Him who created them. Paul says God predestined us to be conformed to the image of His Son, and that as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe being made in God's image is the dignity of every person, and being remade into Christ's image is the goal of my life. My position is that the image is not something I earn; it is something God restores in me.
RelatedTopics: Image of God; Jesus Christ; Salvation
